contract.name: Tool Permission Execution Contract
contract.description: Tool 执行时 Permission / Scope / Approval 的完整链路

flow.description: 构造 Invocation Context (Subject, Scope, CharacterID, ExtensionID)
从 Invocation Context + ResourceURI 推导 Scope Facts
PermissionGate.evaluateWithBroker 调用 Broker.Evaluate(Invocation ID, Subject, Requirements, Scope)
ApprovalGate 通过 Broker.Explain 决定是否触发人工审批
进入 awaiting_approval 状态，等待 B43 Cancel 或 B44 Timeout
所有 Gate 通过后进入 Dispatcher.Dispatch
RuntimeAdapter 消费已授权执行；Provider 仅做 OS Authorization
结果写入 + 副作用记录

authorities.provider: 权限消费者 (只能消费已授权执行, 不得自行决定 Kernel Permission)
authorities.osAuthorization: 平台独立必要条件 (Android/iOS/Desktop OS API)
